decisions: Tooling track: the hint changes no emitted C, so no phases.toml option; it adds a summary.runtime field and a stderr note.
The note goes to stderr before dispatch so JSON stdout is untouched; --summary carries the rows itself and prints a note only when its load fails.
The PE walk skips the MZ check so a damaged DOS header (Flare-On 12 UnholyDragon) is still named; repairing it is out of scope.
Go/Rust come from the existing sourcelang verdict and are informational (actionable false), so they never add a stderr line.
